facts.fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency says quality assessments of administrative data for agriculture, labour market information and civil registration (CRVS) were concluded by a consultant under its quality framework, with agreements for agriculture and LMIS concluded and departments enhancing scope from the results.
facts.system: Administrative Data for Disaggregated SDGs Indicators

NAM.note: Satellite work named is for SDG 6.6.1 water ecosystems, not farming.
Nothing stated on a civil register to ID link.
Census work is mentioned only as slowing admin data work; no census or survey stated.
CRVS is named only as a data exchange target and a quality assessment; no digital register stated.

facts.fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency says a National Data Exchange Platform is being developed with Estonia, with infrastructure and connection established and NamRA as first testing point, then the Office of the Prime Minister for CRVS data; partners include the Bank of Namibia and Ministry of Home Affairs.
